# In Flames - Bootlegs & Live Shows Archive

> The most complete community archive of In Flames bootlegs and live recordings: 200+ documented live
> shows spanning the band's Swedish roots in 1994 all the way to today, across 30+ countries. Each entry
> links to available video footage (pro-shot, amateur, or full-show) and Setlist.fm pages.

The archive has two sections: the searchable home page listing full live shows, and a Miscellaneous
page listing one-off performances that are not full concerts. On the home page, visitors can filter
shows by year, country, city, and song in the setlist, then sort chronologically. It is a
non-commercial fan project; all recordings and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

## Key facts

- Artist: In Flames (melodic death metal, formed 1990 in Gothenburg, Sweden)
- Shows documented: 200+ (1994–2026)
- Countries covered: 30+
- Data per show: title, date, city, country, setlist, media link, Setlist.fm link, and footage
  availability flags (pro-shot, video, full show)
- Curated by: A Jester's Collection (https://jesterscollection.kiriancaumes.fr/)

## Miscellaneous performances

A second section documents one-off In Flames performances outside regular concerts: award ceremonies
(P3 Guld, Grammisgalan, Rockbjornen, Metal Hammer Awards), acoustic radio and studio sessions
(iRockRadio, HardDrive Online, Studioeast), and guest features with other artists (Will Ramos of Lorna
Shore, Matthew Heafy of Trivium, Mikael Stanne of Dark Tranquillity, Timo Raisanen).

- Data per performance: title, date, event, song(s) performed, media link, and footage availability
  flags (pro-shot, video)
- Page: https://in-flames-bootlegs.kiriancaumes.fr/miscellaneous

## Links
